name: nr_channel_models
description: 独立 Python 显式路径信道子集；不包含 MATLAB 预设 TDL/CDL/HST 配置和相位噪声多极点模型。
implementation: Standalone NumPy implementation; explicit limited coverage in tool_registry.json.

params.description: JSON 对象字符串。TDL/CDL: samples,sample_rate,delays,gains,dopplers；HST: samples,sample_rate,speed_mps,carrier_hz；PathLoss: freq_hz,bs,ue,los,scenario=FSPL|UMa；PerfectChannelEstimate: path_gains,delays,sample_rate,nfft,nsc；PhaseNoise: samples,sample_rate,linewidth_hz,seed。复数数据用 {real:[...],imag:[...]}。

function.description: 调用的 MATLAB 入口名

result.description: 该入口的结构化计算结果

example.result: 按入口参数返回 JSON 对象；缺失必需参数时返回 error
